title: Allegro's theory that the Eucharist was an Amanita muscaria

tellings.quote: he came to the very heretical conclusion that the Eucharist itself was an Amanita muscaria mushroom.

plain: The Eucharist, the bread of Christian communion, is said by one scholar to have been in its origin a mushroom, the red and white Amanita muscaria, which alters the mind. Michels tells this himself, crediting a scholar named John Marco Allegro and his book The Sacred Mushroom and the Cross, and calls it a "very heretical conclusion." If true, it would mean early Christianity grew out of a sacred drug.
